lakon — Lakon, an Object Pascal native compiler

usage: lakon <source-file.pas>
       lakon --dump-ast <source-file.pas>
       lakon compile <source-file.pas> [-o <output.wasm>]

commands:
  compile      compile the program to a WebAssembly
               module (default output: source name with .wasm)

options:
  --dump-ast   parse the source file and print its AST
  -o           output path for compile
  -Fu <dir>     additional unit search directory (repeatable)
  -d <sym>      define a conditional symbol in every
               compiled file (repeatable; also -d<sym>)
  --no-cache   ignore and do not write the unit symbol cache
  --verbose-units
               report the per-unit compile/cache decisions
  --no-inline
               disable the inline-directive optimizer (debugging/bisection;
               program output is identical either way)
  --inline-stats
               report honored/skipped inline routines and expanded call sites
  --help       show this help
  --version    print the version and exit

Without a command the source file is lexed and its token
stream printed, one token per line; --dump-ast parses the
full grammar and prints the syntax tree.
